Add a Vantor Vivid Mosaic Basemap to a Leaflet Map

Source: R/vantor_leaflet.R
add_vantor_basemap.Rd

Adds a high-resolution Vantor / Maxar Vivid Mosaic basemap (VIVID_STANDARD_30 or VIVID_ADVANCED_15) to a leaflet or leafletProxy map widget using either pre-cached OGC WMTS tiles (recommended for fast interactive panning) or dynamic OGC WMS rendering.

Usage

add_vantor_basemap(
  map,
  product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
  service = c("WMTS", "WMS"),
  api_key = NULL,
  group = "Vantor Vivid",
  layerId = NULL,
  show_seamlines = FALSE,
  cql_filter = NULL,
  shoreline_masking = FALSE,
  max_zoom = 21L,
  attribution = "Imagery &copy; Vantor / Maxar Technologies",
  options = NULL,
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

addVantorBasemap(
  map,
  product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
  service = c("WMTS", "WMS"),
  api_key = NULL,
  group = "Vantor Vivid",
  layerId = NULL,
  show_seamlines = FALSE,
  cql_filter = NULL,
  shoreline_masking = FALSE,
  max_zoom = 21L,
  attribution = "Imagery &copy; Vantor / Maxar Technologies",
  options = NULL,
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

map

A leaflet or leaflet_proxy map widget object.

product

Character string. Vivid product name. Default is "VIVID_STANDARD_30". Options include "VIVID_STANDARD_30" (30 cm) and "VIVID_ADVANCED_15" (15 cm).

service

Character string. OGC service protocol: "WMTS" (default, fastest in browser) or "WMS".

api_key

Character string. Optional Vantor/Maxar API key. If NULL, resolved from session authentication (vantor_auth()) or environment variables (VANTOR_API_KEY / MAXAR_API_KEY).

group

Character string. Name of the leaflet layer group. Default is "Vantor Vivid".

layerId

Character string. Optional leaflet layer ID.

show_seamlines

Logical. If TRUE, also overlays the corresponding cutline/seamline layer via add_vantor_seamlines(). Default is FALSE.

cql_filter

Character string. Optional custom CQL filter.

shoreline_masking

Logical. Apply shoreline masking (used when service = "WMS"). Default is FALSE.

max_zoom

Integer. Maximum zoom level for the tile layer. Default is 21L.

attribution

Character string. Map attribution text.

options

A list of tile options passed to leaflet::tileOptions() or leaflet::WMSTileOptions().

verbose

Logical. Print status messages. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

The modified leaflet or leaflet_proxy map object.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("leaflet", quietly = TRUE)) {
  m <- leaflet::leaflet() |>
    add_vantor_basemap(
      product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
      api_key = "example_api_key",
      verbose = FALSE
    )
}
